cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: Surface must be clean, sound, smooth and dust-free as well as oil-free. A layer of diluted Sikalastic®-487 membrane (with 10% Thinner C) can be used as a primer for dry and contaminants-free concrete. In the case of high porosity, it is recommended to use an epoxy primer. Please see 'priming' section below for further information.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.

s: Dry film thickness: 2 coats of a minimum of 680 microns (WFT) are required to achieve a 1.2mm dry film thickness.
Drying time: 24 hours for full cure.
r: 2 coats of a minimum of 680 microns (WFT) are required to achieve a 1.2mm dry film thickness.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Waiting time to overcoating
cl.x: In normal conditions, Sikalastic®-487 can be recoated with another layer of Sikalastic®-487 after one night and within 2 days. In case of rain or if the recoating interval was exceeded, light abrasion and reactivate Sikalastic®-487 with Sika Thinner C or for the best results remove the existing coating back to substrate and re-apply.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application
tb: Up to 10m2 per Litre (refer to pds)

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application > NOTES
cl.x: -The above consumption rates are indicative only and can fluctuate depending on porosity of surface being primed.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application > MEMBRANE APPLICATION
s: Sikalastic®-487 can be applied with a brush or a roller to the desired thickness.
2 coats of 680 micron (WFT) are required to achieve a dry film thickness of 1.2mm.
Sikalastic®-487 can be subject to light foot traffic and screed applications after 24 hours.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Reusable tools should be cleaned carefully with Sika Thinner C before curing.
Do not install Sikalastic®-487 without the use of a primer. Do not under apply Sikalastic®-487 as this will impact the products performance and cause premature degradation.
